theme: An open Sunday with a quiet handoff at dusk.
greeting: The calendar's nearly empty today, Dan — one short review with Mike this morning, then the day is your own until the girls head back to Jen this evening.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is slipping
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market, and the task has been open since Sep 14. Book a refundable one now and adjust the dates once the trip firms up.

needsAttention.title: December trip, book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip for all four kids needs a destination decided and booked by Oct 15 — holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. The default is a domestic shortlist, since passports only land in November.
